purpose: Index immutable property fixture governance snapshots so historical states can be located and compared without overwriting prior records.
index_rules: Every governance snapshot receives one immutable index entry.
A material governance state change requires a new snapshot and index entry.
The index does not itself establish legal facts or publication readiness.
comparison_rules: Compare snapshots by capture date and governance version.
Identify additions, removals and state transitions explicitly.
Never treat a later technical state as retroactive correction of an earlier snapshot.
Legal-source changes must be evaluated separately from technical governance changes.
A snapshot comparison cannot independently authorize publication.
guardrails: Snapshot indexing is technical governance only.
Synthetic fixture states cannot establish real-world property facts.
No index entry may claim live official-record retrieval without a corresponding retrieval event.
